_note: WI5 fixture — intentionally malformed to prove the XSD gate fires. Drops productIdentifiers entirely, so Export emits <Product> without any <ProductIdentifier> child. ONIX 3.0 reference XSD requires at least one <ProductIdentifier> per Product (gp.product_numbers, minOccurs default 1). xmllint surfaces this as 'DescriptiveDetail: This element is not expected. Expected is one of (..., ProductIdentifier)' because the validator was looking for ProductIdentifier when it hit DescriptiveDetail. Tests assert {:error, reasons} with 'ProductIdentifier' in the reason list.
